description: Generate a UK jurisdiction-aware contract (nda, service_agreement, freelance_agreement, recruiter_terms_of_business, or ir35_agreement). Collect all required fields through conversation before calling — never invent party names, addresses, dates, or amounts. On a validation error, read error.suggestion in the response and fix the request yourself.

contract_type.description: Which contract to generate. Call list_contract_templates if unsure which fields each type needs.

deliverables.description: service_agreement only — required for that type.

jurisdiction_other.description: Required only when jurisdiction is INTERNATIONAL.

output_format.description: Default markdown. pdf returns a 1-hour signed download URL instead.

parties.description: Exactly two parties, in order: party_a first, then party_b.

payment.description: Payment terms — shape depends on contract_type (service_agreement/freelance_agreement/ir35_agreement). Call list_contract_templates for the exact fields.

scope_of_work.description: Plain-English description of what this contract covers.

name: generate_contract
title: Generate a contract
